prompt:
## Task
Do A and B name the same business concept (the same real-world thing, so the classes model one concept under different names)? Concepts that merely share attributes such as an id or a date are not the same.

### A
concept: Hive Scale
where: ScaleRepository (uses), src/persistence/repositories.ts, component persistence
code:
=====SOURCE-BEGIN
private readonly items = new Map<string, ScaleRecord>();
=====SOURCE-END=====

### B
concept: Hive
where: ScaleService (uses), src/business/scaleService.ts, component business

const hive = this.hives.findById(hiveId);
=====SOURCE-END=====

response.rationale: A Hive Scale is a weighing device: ScaleRepository stores ScaleRecord entries ("private readonly items = new Map<string, ScaleRecord>();"), and per the graph, ScaleService looks them up with findBySerial and findByHive. A Hive is the beehive itself, loaded from a separate HiveRepository ("const hive = this.hives.findById(hiveId);"). They are stored in separate repositories, and findByHive suggests each scale is linked to a hive. That is a link between two concepts (a scale weighs a hive), not one concept under two names.
